_comment: Per-machine overlay. Copy to machine.json (gitignored) and edit.
Only put here what genuinely varies between hosts: extra directories,
env vars, and deliberate per-host opt-ins such as
Merge semantics: dicts recurse, lists concatenate and dedupe,
NOTE: HOOK_ALLOW_* guard overrides must be exported before
launching claude. Bootstrap refuses one set in the env block below
(or in any settings layer). An inline prefix on a command
(HOOK_ALLOW_PATHS=1 cat ...) only affects that command's process —
the guard hook is a separate process and never sees it.
